items.title: Puget Systems at SIGGRAPH 2026: The Robo Dojo
items.excerpt: Puget Systems and Form Studios built a SIGGRAPH activation where attendees control a fully-realized MetaHuman in real time to fight AI robots, now driven by a single-sensor LiDAR system instead of a camera-heavy mocap rig. The booth also demoed Beeble AI relighting and Volinga 3D Gaussian Splatting.

items.title: Vigloo Studio: New AI Platform for Short-Form Microdramas
items.excerpt: Vigloo Studio, an AI-native production platform from Korea, launched in beta to help creators produce serialized short-form dramas at sharply reduced cost, consolidating AI video and image generation and character management into a single environment.

items.title: Foundry Adds Griptape Enterprise for Pro-Grade AI in VFX
items.excerpt: Foundry announced Griptape Enterprise, an AI workflow-orchestration tier with studio-controlled licensing and on-prem deployment that lets pipeline supervisors curate exactly which AI models artists use, keeping VFX workflows vetted and production-ready.

items.title: Jamie Hearing on how Clear Angle is scanning the future of VFX
items.excerpt: From LiDAR to Gaussian splats, Clear Angle Studios has become a key part of the modern VFX pipeline, capturing faces, objects and locations so teams can rebuild the real world digitally — a look at how neural capture is reshaping on-set data acquisition.

items.title: Foundry's SmartRoto: AI-assisted roto that aims to work the way you do
items.excerpt: Foundry released SmartRoto, an AI-powered plugin for Nuke, NukeX, Nuke Studio and Nuke Indie built on a proprietary machine-learning model trained over four years. Artists key significant frames and SmartRoto snaps roto splines into place across a shot — up to 4x faster than manual rotoscoping while keeping spline-based precision and artist control.

items.title: Lightcraft Technology Opens Spark Story Beta at SIGGRAPH 2026
items.excerpt: Lightcraft opened a rolling beta of Spark Story, a browser-based interactive previs system that loads Final Draft scripts, parses them for locations and characters, and ties every shot to a scene. It ships with 25+ World Labs 'Marble' environments and 300+ 3D assets, plus Gaussian splats, USD import and real-time 24p iOS live-action compositing so global teams can workshop a virtual film set from day one.
